compounddef.title: Project: Adding Bit-field or DriverLib Support

detaileddescription.para: MCPC029 devices support two types of development software, driver library APIs and bit-field structures. Each have their advantages and are implemented to be compatible together within the same user application. This section details how to add driverlib support to a bit-field project as well as how to add bit-field support to a driverlib project.

When combining bit-field and driverlib support, add a pre-defined symbol within the project properties called "_DUAL_HEADERS". This is required to avoid having conflicting definitions (in enums/structs/macros) which share the exact same names in both bit-field and driverlib headers.
